assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is medically necessary to identify the underlying arrhythmia associated with the patient's embolic events
The payment is bundled into another covered procedure under denial code CO-97
